Title: moveWishlistItem — Between Two Lists
Preconditions: Runner-native. Uses BUYABLE_NO_MIN_QTY product (Canvas Pencil Case ALCOE9535, minQuantity:1) to avoid PRODUCT_MIN_MAX_QTY silent rejection on destination's internal AddItemsAsync call. Original setup_prod filter returned LG55EG9600 (minQuantity:7), which silently destroys items on move (VCST-5112). Captures real product GUID, creates 2 wishlists, adds 1 item to source, moves it to dest, verifies source empty and dest populated. Now also projects items.validationErrors at every items[] read so any line-item-level rejection signal would surface — though VCST-5112 schema gap means destination-aggregate rejections still cannot surface through wishlist projections.
Assertions:
[ERRORS label=setup_prod] errors[] empty — Canvas Pencil Case must resolve (BUYABLE_NO_MIN_QTY guarantee)
[DATA label=setup_prod] data.products.items.0.code = @td(BUYABLE_NO_MIN_QTY.code)
[DATA label=setup_prod] data.products.items.0.minQuantity = 1
[ERRORS label=add_item] errors[] empty
[COUNT label=add_item] data.addWishlistItem.itemsCount = 1
[ERRORS label=move] errors[] empty
[COUNT label=move] data.moveWishlistItem.itemsCount = 1
[DATA label=move] data.moveWishlistItem.items.0.productId = {{PRODUCT_ID}}
[ERRORS label=verify_dest] errors[] empty
[COUNT label=verify_dest] data.wishlist.itemsCount = 1
[DATA label=verify_dest] data.wishlist.items.0.productId is non-null
[DATA label=verify_dest] data.wishlist.items.0.sku = @td(BUYABLE_NO_MIN_QTY.sku)
[ERRORS label=verify_src] errors[] empty
[COUNT label=verify_src] data.wishlist.itemsCount = 0
Cross_Layer_Checks:
[ROUNDTRIP label=move] moveWishlistItem returns the DESTINATION wishlist state (itemsCount=1 after move). verify_dest also confirms destination=1, verify_src confirms source emptied.
[EVIDENCE] items[].validationErrors projection added for future-proofing — VCST-5112 schema gap means destination-aggregate rejections (PRODUCT_MIN_MAX_QTY etc.) cannot surface through wishlist projections today. WishlistType lacks the aggregate-level validationErrors field that CartType has.
Failure_Signals: errors[] non-empty; item remains in source; missing from destination; duplicated in both; data.wishlist.items.0.validationErrors non-empty (would indicate destination silently accepted a rejected item)
